detail:
Branch lane/05-verification (worktree). No src/** edits; one oracle edit (C18 structured invariants, normalization only, original kept verbatim as INV-1).

BUILT
- test/acceptance/harness/ — oracles.ts (fixture loader + assertion-id inventory + identity-overlap metric), identity.ts (World/Replica, cold restart, credential separation), scenario.ts (envelope builders, deliver/settle, fs+relay carriers, fault hooks), switchboard.ts (6 instrument-can-fail controls with declared input/observe injection modes), scenario-fixture.ts, index.ts, plus two self-tests.
- switchboard.test.ts: 13/13 pass. Each control runs its negative assertion twice — holds with the control ON, FAILS with it OFF. scope_filter_off→N-SCOPE, trust_check_off→N-TRUST, dedup_off→N-DEDUP, byte_preservation_off→N-BYTES, class_rank_off→N-RANK, conflict_detection_off→N-CONFLICT. No control defects found.
- oracles.test.ts: 156/156 pass. 28 cases, all fixtures parse, 23 held-out variants, dev/held-out identity overlap 0% (22 pairs) and 7% (C08).
- test/acceptance/oracles/INDEX.md (generated by scripts/qualify/build-oracle-index.ts): 1230 tracked ids, 1103 owned by a lane, 127 unowned, 124 already cited in an existing test file.
- scripts/qualify/c28-remote/ — README runbook, run.sh (clone at commit, disposable BARE git remote, phases as separate OS processes), c28-scenario.ts, verify-bundle.ts. Locally: 12 pass, 1 FAIL (A13 = F-PENDING), 21 not-tested. UNTESTED ON A SECOND MACHINE until Dave runs it.
- docs/operations/data-flow.md (mermaid + 7-row outbound table + findings), scripts/measure/observe-traffic.sh, docs/operations/recovery-and-rollback.md (skeleton, TODOs attributed per lane), scripts/measure/corpus.ts, test/acceptance/cases/README.md + C03/C13/C23/C27/C28 todo stubs.

HONESTY BOUNDARIES (do not quote past these)
- 3 of the 6 controls are `observe` mode: the defect lives in src/** which lane 05 may not edit, so the switch interposes on the assertion's read path using the store's own durable events. That proves the ASSERTION is sensitive to the defect; it is NOT evidence the shipped code enforces the control. The oracle-derived slice tests carry that burden.
- The C28 bundle runs on ONE machine over a shared-directory (or git-backed directory) carrier. Per C28 A24 that makes the case UNAVAILABLE, never PASSED. src/exchange/git-transport.ts does not exist at this commit, so the ADR 8.2 exchange-ref topology, the dirty-tree guarantee and commit-sha receipts are untested.
- observe-traffic.sh observes destinations, not payloads, and does not block. An empty result is weak evidence, not proof of absence.

OWNERSHIP QUESTIONS FOR THE LEAD
C03 is listed under lane 04's "C01-C09" AND as unowned in the lane-05 dispatch. C27 is listed under lane 03 AND as unowned. Both need a ruling before either lane writes the test.
summary: Lane 05 preparatory phase: shared acceptance harness + instrument-can-fail switchboard (6/6 controls proven to fail), oracle INDEX.md, C28 remote bundle, data-flow + recovery docs
